reports.title: Mantle Network (Token Migration) Audit (Quantstamp)
reports.description: Quantstamp audit (1 to 12 June 2023) with fix review of the L1MantleToken (MNT) and MantleTokenMigrator (BIT to MNT migration) contracts in mantle-token-contracts. The High finding MNT-1 (conversion ratio not guaranteed to be 1:1) was fixed in commit b187163; the other findings were Medium or lower.

reports.title: Mantle Token and Bridge Audit (OpenZeppelin)
reports.description: OpenZeppelin audit (6 to 13 June 2023) of the Mantle v1 L1MantleToken (MNT) and MantleTokenMigrator contracts in mantle-token-contracts and the forked L1/L2 StandardBridge contracts in the mantle repository, assuming the cross-domain messengers work as documented. No Critical, High or Medium issues were found; three Low and thirteen Note findings were reported, with fixes reviewed in individual pull request commits.

reports.title: Mantle Smart Contract Security Assessment (Zellic)
reports.description: Zellic assessment (7 to 9 June 2023) of L1MantleToken and MantleTokenMigrator in mantle-token-contracts and the forked L1/L2 StandardBridge contracts in the mantle repository. One High finding (3.1, initialize not guarded by the initializer modifier in L1StandardBridge) was fixed in commit a53dd95; the remaining findings were Low or Informational.

reports.title: Mantle Network (Bridge Contracts) Audit (Quantstamp)
reports.description: Quantstamp audit (2 to 16 June 2023) with fix review of the Mantle v1 L1StandardBridge and L2StandardBridge contracts (forked from Optimism afdd020) in the mantle repository; the cross-chain transport layer and bridged tokens were out of scope. The High finding MANB-1 (incompatible ERC-20 tokens can lock funds) was acknowledged, not fixed.

reports.title: Mantle L2 Rollup Security Assessment (Sigma Prime)
reports.description: Sigma Prime time-boxed review of the Mantle v1 mantle repository at commit 3e2b6db, covering the Solidity contracts (TSS group manager and staking/slashing, EigenDA data-layer chain, predeploys, bridges) and the Go components (TSS, l2geth, mt-batcher, mt-challenger, fraud-proof, batch-submitter, proxyd and the datalayr-mantle submodule), with OpenZeppelin dependencies excluded. It reported 38 findings including 1 Critical and 5 High, with resolutions in follow-up pull requests and commits.
